import subprocess
h=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
r=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-remote','origin','refs/heads/main'],text=True).split()[0]
s=subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--short','--untracked-files=all'],text=True).splitlines()
print({'head':h[:8],'remote_matches':h==r,'remaining_non_dip_files':[x for x in s if not x[3:].startswith('.dip/')], 'remaining_dip_events':len([x for x in s if x[3:].startswith('.dip/')])})
